summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly open-market repurchases of its ordinary shares and American Depositary Shares under a previously announced buyback programme (initiated 20 May 2025). During April 13-17, 2026, it bought 10,000 ordinary shares (avg. prices €23.94–€25.748) and 574,158 ADSs (avg. $29.107–$31.5155). All purchased shares are to be cancelled. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexities are noted. Watch for ongoing pace of buyback execution and impact on share float; risk-arb angle is not applicable as this is a routine capital return, not an event-driven situation with excess return expectations.
